unmet_need_hypothesis: Non-technical creators handling local deliverables may need human-readable dated verification history and safe change-only reports rather than a hash console. Need proof via interviews; free QuickHash already offers comparisons and export.
offline_local_only_advantage: Read-only hashing, no network, no elevated privileges, CSV report; free competitors already work offline.
buyer_persona: Freelance creator or small office clerk verifying a limited set of local deliverables before handoff; unvalidated.
why_pay_statement: NOT PROVEN: current single-snapshot and CSV export are available in free tools; a repeatable visual change ledger and client-facing reports may be differentiated but are not yet shipped or buyer-validated.

price_hypothesis.redesigned_candidate: JPY 700–1500 one-time if nontechnical report workflow is validated

proposed_redefinition.name: Local Deliverable Verification Log
differentiators: Multiple named dated snapshots with visual change-only timeline and non-destructive re-verification
One-click printable human-readable client handoff report explaining modified/missing/unreadable states
constraints: No repair, signing, provenance or tamper-proof claims
Keep symlink, file-change-during-hash, large-file and CSV formula injection protections
Do not duplicate Windows-checker Store package validation
needs_validation: Performance and partial-failure tests on real Windows files

gate_policy: <70: Store work forbidden; 70-79 redesign; >=80 candidate only if all GO criteria met
current_feature_evidence: Current README: up to 100 selected files, 256 MiB each, SHA-256 baseline and verification, CSV export, no repair, headless tests. Multiple snapshot history not documented as shipped.
remaining_market_research: Verify Directory Monitor US/Japan regional prices
provenance_note: Desk research 2026-10-30; price and feature claims cited by source URLs. Reviews are sparse and anecdotal, so MARKET_FIT_HOLD.
